{{Top|leg}}
'''Black Sabacc''' was a [[Band/Legends|band]] that was active during the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Galactic War]]. They were friends of [[Bey'wan Aygo]]'s family, and he used that connection to book them for a few nights at the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance's]] [[Alliance base|base]] on [[Odessen]].

==Behind the scenes==
Black Sabacc is a reference to the English heavy metal band [[Wikipedia:Black Sabbath|Black Sabbath]].
